items.question: Into what three traditional types is the fire-rite classified?
premises: The fire-rite is the subject being classified.
One type of fire-rite is vedic.
One type of fire-rite is mixed.
One type of fire-rite is shaiva.
items.inference: Therefore, the fire-rite is traditionally remembered as threefold: vedic, mixed, and shaiva.
items.plain_english: The fire-rite is traditionally remembered as threefold: vedic, mixed, and shaiva.
